Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misapplied a “mass-fraction adjustment,” effectively reducing the water mass by 2.5% and then adding the salt back, arriving at 1000 g. This violates conservation of mass for mixtures; the correct mixture mass is simply the sum of component masses: 1000 g water + 25 g salt = 1025 g (Option C). The Planner also prematurely marked the task complete without proper verification.
